summary: This note covers the doubles competition at the 2011 Family Circle Cup. The pair Mirza and Vesnina reached the final and won it against the American duo of Bethanie Mattek-Sands and Meghann Shaughnessy. The final score was 6–4, 6–4.
one_line: Mirza and Vesnina won the 2011 Family Circle Cup doubles final against Mattek-Sands and Shaughnessy.
key_facts: Mirza and Vesnina reached the final of the 2011 Family Circle Cup doubles.
Mirza and Vesnina won the final against the American pair of Bethanie Mattek-Sands and Meghann Shaughnessy.
Bethanie Mattek-Sands and Meghann Shaughnessy were the American pair defeated in the final.
